style.styleTitle: Decoris Set of 3 Shoe Christmas Glass Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Step up your holiday decor with this playful set of glass shoe baubles from Decoris. Featuring a detailed sneaker, clog, and slipper, these quirky ornaments add a modern, fashion-forward twist to your tree. Finished in soft pearl tones with delicate glitter accents, they catch the light beautifully, bringing a cheerful, seasonal sparkle to branches of any size.</p><ul><li>Material: glass figure in shoe shape<br></li><li>Dimensions: length 5.1 cm, width 4.4 cm, height 11 cm<br></li><li>Colour scheme in pearl tones with coloured decorative accents<br></li><li>Gold coloured aluminium cap with matching decorative detailing</li><li>Ready to hang with attached gold wire for easy placement on branches</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This glass shoe figure from Decoris is designed for decorating a Christmas tree with a playful, modern touch. The detailed sneaker, clog, and slipper shapes stand out among classic baubles and bring a fun twist to festive styling. Soft pearl tones combined with subtle colour accents and glitter details create a cheerful, seasonal sparkle on the tree. The compact size works well on both small and large branches, creating a striking visual on the Christmas tree without overpowering other decorations. Material: glass figure in shoe shape. Dimensions: length 5.1 cm, width 4.4 cm, height 11 cm. Colour scheme in pearl tones with coloured decorative accents. Gold aluminium cap with matching decorative detailing. Ready to hang with attached gold wire for easy placement on branches.
